title: Compactly supported integer multiplicity currents have finite mass
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every integer multiplicity current T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with compact support spt T has finite mass M(T) < ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsCompact T.support → T.mass < ∞
